title: 'Psyren' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced supporting cast on Monday. The anime series premiered on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV.

Cast Kagetora Hyoudou: Takaya Kuroda ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) Ian: Wataru Komada ( One Punch Man 3 ) Kyle Tenjuin: Mutsumi Tamura ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) Shao Tenjuin: Mitsuki Saiga ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier ) Frederica Tenjuin: Ayana Taketatsu ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e ) Marie Tenjuin: Kana Ichinose ( Medalist )

Katsumi Ono ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) is directing the anime at Satelight , with Shin Yoshida ( Sacred Seven ) handling the series composition. Shiro Ookuma ( Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume o Minai animation director) is designing the characters. Takashi Oomama ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( Ore wa Subete wo "Parry" suru ), and Shuu Kanematsu ( Hametsu no Oukoku ) are composing the music.

Iwashiro drew the sci-fi action manga in Weekly Shounen Jump from December 2007 to November 2010. Shueisha published the 16th and final volume in March 2011.

SOW penned a side story light novel with illustrations by Iwashiro under Shueisha's Jump J Books imprint from September 2010 to March 2011.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in April 2010 and published the 16th and final volume in May 2014.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Teases Yuno’s Next Big Power Up
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is reaching its final phase as the Spade Kingdom Raid arc is winding down its final battles, and the first look preview for the next episode of the series is setting the stage for Yuno’s next big power up. With the first two members of the Dark Triad now defeated , all that stands in the way of the Advent of Qliphoth ritual is Zenon Zogratis. While Yuno and Langris had been able to deal damage to him, the end of the latest episode saw him strike a terrible deal.

Black Clover Season 2 saw Yuno and Langris pretty much defeat Zenon thanks to their teamwork , but the Zogratis sibling saved himself by making a new deal with the Supreme Devil, Beelzebub. Giving himself a devil’s heart and new strength as a result, Yuno is now struggling to survive. But the first look images and synopsis for Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 teases that Yuno is about to unlock a whole new power. Check them out in the gallery below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 First Look Images & Synopsis Revealed

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 9 is titled “Yuno Grinberryall” and will be making its debut in Japan on November 28th, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. With the latest episode seeing Zenon strike a deal that pretty much puts him on the same level of a Supreme Devil, Yuno and Langris are pretty much out of options. Even with Finral arriving to help, there’s still a huge gap in their respective abilities. But the synopsis teases how the scales will balance.

“Yuno, Langris, and Finral are in dire straits under attack from Zenon, who has obtained the heart of a demon,” the synopsis begins. “Despite being chosen as the vice-captain of the Golden Dawn, the strongest magic knight squad in the Clover Kingdom, Yuno gnashes his teeth at his inability to protect his comrades, when a grimoire descends upon him.” By the sounds of things, Yuno is about to unlock a whole new kind of magic he didn’t have before. And it ties to the title of the episode, which fully reveals Yuno’s name . We’ll have to see what that means for the fight moving forward.

What’s Next for Black Clover Season 2?

Each new episode of Black Clover Season 2 thus far has been packed to the brim with materials adapted from Yuki Tabata’s original manga, and that means these war events have been speeding towards their eventual conclusion. Because while this fight with Zenon is surely going to get a lot of focus, the synopsis also teases other key points in the fight, “Meanwhile, at the site of the Qliphoth’s arrival, Dorothy’s dream magic is defeated by Morris, who has acquired the power of a demon.” But that’s not all as the Black Bulls make their move too.

“Just as the gate to the second level of the Underworld is about to open, members of the Black Bulls arrive on their Black Raging Bull to rescue Yami!” the synopsis concludes. The Spade Kingdom Raid arc is quickly reaching its conclusion with the end of this second season, so it remains to be seen what’s next for the anime as it readies for the grand finale after . What do you hope to see from Yuno in Black Clover ‘s next episode? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen’s Gojo Actor Has a Role in GTA 6 & You Probably Missed It
content:
Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s English voice actor, Kaiji Tang, has a role in GTA 6 , and the story behind how he voiced the characters is hilarious. The latest entry in the Grand Theft Auto franchise has broken records unlike anything seen before in entertainment media. Rockstar’s massive open-world game is filled with characters and details that fans are still discovering, and it will likely take months or even years before everything hidden in the game is uncovered. With hundreds of characters featured in the game, numerous voice actors have also had the opportunity to be part of this massive project, including several from the anime industry.

The English voice actor for Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Gojo Satoru voices not one but three different characters in the game, and finding them can be difficult, as it requires fans to pay attention to one particular element. Following the game’s release, on November 19, Kaiji Tang took to X to announce his involvement, revealing that he had no idea he was recording for the game and was just as surprised to discover his roles after its release. Thankfully, Kaiji also informed fans how they can catch his performances in the game, and it requires them to simply sit back and enjoy what the game has to offer, quite literally.

GTA 6 Features Gojo’s Voice Actor in Three Different Animated Roles

Kaiji revealed on his X account that fans can find him by watching the cartoons featured in the game. GTA 6 features a fictional original sitcom named The Johnsons , which fans can discover by watching television in the game. Kaiji voices three different characters: Jax, the therapist, and the “Guy in the Parking Lot.” All three are comedic roles that perfectly match the show’s tone. What makes this even more hilarious is that the voice actor had no idea what he was recording for. His reply to a fan, in which he revealed that he thought he was recording for Demon Slayer , makes the whole situation even funnier, especially since Kaiji voices the rowdy Wind Hashira, who fans can hear delivering the dialogue, “Sit on daddy’s lap.”

GTA 6 has plenty of hidden gems and talent from various industries, including anime, movies, and many others. While seeing Gojo Satoru directly in the game as an NPC or a character resembling him would have been an even bigger shock, it is still a surprising connection to discover even through such a small detail, leaving open the possibility of something similar happening in the future. Gojo Satoru has emerged as one of the faces of the anime industry, much like other iconic characters such as Goku, Naruto, and Luffy. Considering the numerous collaborations featuring these characters, Gojo reaching the same level of recognition is entirely possible.

All of this could become even more possible once Gojo Satoru returns to the anime after his imprisonment, showcasing his immense charm and strength in the series’ final arc. His presence as a representative of the anime industry could become even more solidified, and while it may not happen in GTA 6 , Gojo Satoru could potentially appear as himself in a future DLC or another major game.

title: 'Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Haka Tokura and Shin Arakawa 's Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made ( Magical Buffs: The Support Caster Is Stronger Than He Realized! ) manga announced additional cast on Monday. The anime will be broadcast on Tokyo MX, MBS, and BS11 on January 4.

Cast Nikura: Yuuki Hirose ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru ) Melis: Natsumi Takamori ( Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen ) Sophia: Yuka Nukui ( Fate/strange Fake )

Hideki Okamoto ( 2.5-jigen no Ririsa ) is directing the series at J.C.Staff . Takao Yoshioka ( Horimiya ) is handling series composition and Yuu Murakami ( Nanatsu no Maken ga Shihai suru animation director ) is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ), Luke Standridge , and Asa Taylor ( Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. ) are composing the music.

Arakawa began serializing the manga adaptation of Tokura's action fantasy novel on the Gaugau Monster web service in September 2021. The 12th volume went on sale on August 28, with the 13th volume scheduled for a December 24 release.

Tokura originally began writing the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2020. Futabasha began publishing the light novel under its Monster Novel imprint with illustrations by Eiri Shirai in September 2021. The fourth volume went on sale on June 30.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both the light novel and manga in English in May 2025 and May 2024, respectively. The second novel volume shipped on June 16, with the third volume scheduled to be released on October 27. The seventh manga volume went on sale on September 22, with the eighth planned to be released on January 19, 2027.

News submitted by red1130

title: Magical Buffs Anime Announces 3 More Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of Haka Tokura 's Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! light novel series announced three more cast members on Monday. The newly announced cast members voice characters who belong in Drachenflügel, Wim's former guild:

Yūki Hirose as Nikola, Drachenflügel's healer

Natsumi Takamori as Mehlis, Drachenflügel's mage

Yuka Nukui as Sophia, an elff who joined Drachenflügel as Wim's successor

Granting casters like Wim Strauss play an important supporting role for their team when times get tough, but after his talents hurt the pride of his party's leader, he's kicked out of the group! Yet he's not down and out for long. Wim's luck takes a turn when he receives an invitation from his longtime childhood friend (and stalker) Heidemarie to join Nachtlibelle, an elite guild considered one of the greatest in the land. His talents may not be the flashiest, but given the chance with his new quirky crew, this supporting act might just be able to prove center stage.

The cast includes:

• Reiji Kawashima as Wim Strauss

• Hana Hishikawa as Heidemarie

• Akeno Watanabe as Camilla

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Chronos

• Wakana Kuramochi Rita Heinkes

• Haruki Ishiya as Abel

• Atsushi Ono as Mark

• Yui Ishikawa as Monica

Hideki Okamoto (2.5 Dimesional Seduction, D.C. II: Da Capo II ) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff , and Takao Yoshioka ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , High School DxD , I'm Standing on 1,000,000 Lives. ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yu Murakami is designing the characters based on the original novel illustrations by Eiri Shirai .

Yoshikazu Iwanami is directing the sound, and Yūki Hayashi ( Haikyu!! , My Hero Academia , Observation REcords of My Fiancée), Luke Standridge (Observation Records of My Fiancée), and Asa Taylor (Observation Records of My Fiancée) are composing the music. Ryō Aizawa ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It ) is producing the project.

LiSA is singing the opening theme song "Ecstatic Buffer," for which TK ( Ling Tosite Sigure ) wrote the lyrics, composed the music, and arranged.

The anime will premiere on television on January 4 on Tokyo MX , MBS , BS11 , and "about 20" other channels throughout Japan. It will also have "early streaming" on Netflix , before streaming on other services.

Tokura launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō web platform in November 2020. Arakawa debuted the manga adaptation of the series on the Manga ga Ugau app in September 2021. Futabasha will publish the 13th compiled book volume on December 24.

title: Live-Action Wakako-zake Season 10 Unveils January 6 Debut, Year-End Special, Opening Song Artists
content:
BS TV Tokyo announced the returning cast members, opening theme song artist, and January 6 premiere for the 10th live-action season based on Chie Shinkyū 's Wakako-zake manga on Sunday. Additionally, the series will receive a year-end special episode titled " Wakako-zake Special: Chichibu no Sake Meguri" ( Wakako-zake Special: Sake Tour in Chichibu) that will run the BS TV Tokyo channel on December 30 at 10:30 p.m. JST (8:30 a.m. EST). Idol group Title Mitei is performing the opening theme song "Kyūfu" (Rest) for both the 10th season and the year-end special.

The returning cast members include:

• Yoshihiro Nozoe as Ishida

• Wataru Monma as Yamamoto

• Kanji Tsuda as Komori

• Kenta Kamakari as Aoyagi

• Yamada Kinuo as Arumii-san

• Mizuki Watanabe as Abe-chan

• Takayuki Sakoi as Hasegawa

• Shinya Hasegawa as Itō

• Kōhei Shiotsuka as Manager Okada

The 10th season will premiere on BS TV Tokyo on January 6 at 24:00 JST (effectively January 7 at 12 midnight JST).

Rina Takeda will again star in the series.

For the first time in the series, the season will have episodes set and filmed overseas. Specifically, the production filmed the first two episodes at a beach resort at Australia's Gold Coast, in collaboration with the Tourism Australia agency, Tourism and Events Queensland, Experience Gold Coast, and the airline Qantas.

The Wakako-zake cuisine manga follows 26-year-old Wakako, who drinks different kinds of alcoholic beverages at bars and restaurants alone every night, searching for her place to belong.

Shinkyū started the manga in Coamix 's Monthly Comic Zenon magazine in 2011. Media Do released the first volume of the manga digitally in English on several platforms in October 2018. The manga inspired a 12-episode series of three-minute anime shorts, starring Miyuki Sawashiro , that premiered in July 2015. Crunchyroll streamed the anime series as it aired.

The first 12-episode live-action television season based on the manga aired in January-March 2015, and the second and third 12-episode seasons premiered in January 2016 and April 2017, respectively. The fourth season premiered in January 2019, and the fifth season premiered in April 2020 and aired for 12 episodes. The series had its first special in December 2020. The sixth season premiered in January 2022, and the seventh season premiered in July 2023. The eighth season premiered on January 8, 2025, and the ninth season premiered on October 1, 2025.

title: Champignon Witch Manga to Resume After 10 Months
content:
Hakusensha 's Manga Park platform scheduled a new chapter of Tachibana Higuchi 's Champignon Witch ( Champignon no Majo ) manga in early access for premium users on November 27. This will mark the first new chapter for the series since January.

Yen Press publishes the series in English an describes the story:

Deep within the depths of a murky forest resides a quite peculiar dark witch. Dwelling in an abode created by poisonous mushrooms, leaving toxic fungi in her wake and even exhaling noxious spores with every breath she takes, Luna lives a rather solitary existence. Believing her future would continue in the same vein for the rest of eternity, she is shocked to her core by a sudden dreamlike encounter...

Higuchi launched the manga on Hakusensha 's Manga Park app in October 2019. Hakusensha shipped the seventh compiled book volume on January 20.

The television anime premiered on the TBS channel on January 8 with a one-hour episode. The anime also ran on BS11 and AT-X .

title: 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill' Season 3's New Video Announces More Cast
content:
The staff for the third television anime season based on Miraijin A 's As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ( Tensei Kizoku Kantei Sukiru de Nariagaru - Jakushō Ryōchi o Uketsuidanode, Yūshūna Jinzai o Fuyashite Itara, Saikyō Ryōchi ni Natteta ) light novel series announced three new cast members, along with the fourth promotional video, on Sunday. The "Assassin" arc started in episode 33 on Sunday.

Anna Nagase plays Enan Lugez, a mute girl who volunteered for military service at Canarre Castle.

Kōsuke Toriumi plays Virge Sammado, a young former noble whom Ars encounters in Samkh, claiming to be his distant relative.

Ayumu Murase plays Keefe Venge, a boy with extremely high skill caps in every stat.

Previously announced new cast members are Sumire Morohoshi as Musia Trick, Hinata Tadokoro as Zaht Brouzdo, Toshiya Miyata as Rikuya Fujimiya, Mariya Ise as Maika Fujimiya, and Takaki Ōtomari as Takao Fujimiya.

Takao Kato ( To Love-Ru , Zoids ) returns to direct the third season at new studio GeyeG Pictures . Daisuke Ōhigashi , who wrote episode scripts for the previous seasons, is now overseeing the series scripts, replacing Yasuhiro Nakanishi . Yūko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is also back to design the characters, and Kujira Yumemi ( In the Land of Leadale ) returns to compose the music.

Rico Sasaki performs the season's opening theme song "Still Water," while Akuruyo no Hitsuji performs the ending theme song "Hibi o Koete."

The third anime season premiered on CBC , TBS , and 26 other stations on September 27; on BS NTV on September 29; and on AT-X on October 1. The anime began streaming on U-NEXT , d Anime Store , and Anime Hōdai on September 28, and then on other streaming sites on October 1. Crunchyroll streams the season as it airs.

Kodansha USA Publishing has licensed Natsumi Inoue 's manga adaptation and light novel series (under its Vertical imprint). The company describes the story:

One day when leaving work, Ars Louvent dies and is reborn as a weak aristocrat in another world. Using his “Appraisal” skill, which lets him see the stats of others, he recruits the best people to his side in order to turn his country's fortunes around. Based on a hit light novel with over 30 million online views in Japan!

The first anime season premiered in April 2024 as the debut series for the new "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks.

The second season premiered in Japan in September 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The light novel series debuted in October 2019 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website. Kodansha publishes the light novel series with illustrations by jimmy. The manga adaptation launched in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket in June 2020.

title: Sakamoto Days Manga Ends
content:
This year's 52nd issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump published the final chapter of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga on Monday. Shueisha will publish the manga's 30th compiled book volume on January 4, 2027, followed by the 31st and final volume on April 30.

The manga announced in July that it is heading to its climax. The manga had started its "final battle" in August 2025. The series reached 18 million copies in circulation worldwide in August.

The current Weekly Shonen Jump issue also announced a new series titled Tonari no Tenis-bu no Kimi to (You, in the Neighboring Tennis Club, and I) will begin in the next issue.

Suzuki published a one-shot titled "Sakamoto" in Shueisha 's Jump Giga magazine in December 2019, and then launched the main manga in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in November 2020.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are publishing the manga in English digitally. MANGA Plus describes the manga:

Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villains and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! the chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

Viz Media is also publishing the manga in print.

The manga's spinoff titled Sakamoto Holidays launched in Shueisha 's Saikyō Jump magazine in July 2024. Tetsu Ōkawa , who works as an assistant on the main manga, is drawing the spinoff. Ōkawa reported earlier in November that Sakamoto Holidays is reaching its climax.

The main manga inspired a novel in April 2023, and a second novel shipped in December 2024.

The anime adaptation premiered on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels on January 11, 2025, and the series also debuted on Netflix on that day. The first season's second part premiered on July 14 on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels at 24:00 JST (effectively, July 15 at 12 midnight). The second part's first episode streamed in advance on Netflix on July 14, and only the 12th episode streamed simultaneously with the Japanese TV broadcast.

The second television anime season will premiere on January 18.

The manga also inspired a live-action film that opened on April 29. Yūichi Fukuda (live-action Gintama , Under Ninja ) directed and wrote the script for the film. The film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 346,000 tickets and earned 478 million yen (about US$3.05 million) in its first three days. In its first eight days in the Japanese box office, which spanned the entirety of the Golden Week holidays, the film sold 1.14 million tickets and earned 1.5 billion yen (about US$9.58 million).

title: Dragon Ball Needs to Retcon One of Its Weirdest Android 18 Choices
content:
The story of Dragon Ball is known for being goofy and off-beat beyond the battlefield. For all its serious moments, the story features characters with food names, an afterlife where bad guys are tortured by fairies and Mr. Satan changing to Hercule in the English dub and more amongst other numerous funny bits . One weird bit that should’ve received another edit before making the final cut, however, is Android 17 and 18’s name choice.

Android 17 and 18 are introduced as killing machines in Dragon Ball Z . They were kidnapped and created by the Red Ribbon Army’s Dr. Gero to kill Goku and take over the world. Their almost emotionless violence and super-powered abilities gave them a robot feel. Once Cell is defeated, the human part of them is restored, but their human names are not. It was revealed later by franchise creator Akira Toriyama that their names are Lapis (17) and Lazuli (18 ), however they were never brought into the manga or anime.

Android 18 Stays In Main Story With Old Name

Android 17 becomes a park ranger after the events of the Cell Saga and falls off the radar. Even though this point applies to him too and he deserves to have his name be something other than a number, the plot doesn’t awkwardly point it out time after time. Android 18 on the other hand marries Krillin, gives birth to Marron and becomes a member of the Z Fighters. And yet, her name stays simply, “18.” Anytime Krillin addresses her it’s that same number. An unceremonious way to address one of the anime’s fan favorite characters .

Plot-wise it makes sense to change it. The androids went from humans to bio-mechanical beings, so the number applies and fits their evil personas. Once they’ve transformed back to being normal people, however, a human name makes more sense for a “new-ish” beginning to their lives. The scene from Dragon Ball Super where Future Trunks sees her for the first time since their fight would still have the same terror and humor when he sees her as he associates the name Android 18 with something evil.

Lazuli is much more disarming, and would have changed that interaction overall. Then again, would you expect any less focus toward mid-card characters ? They’re regularly forgotten in the series.

Their Focus in Dragon Ball Super Only Made Their Names Even More Questionable

The awkwardness is only further focused in on when you remember that the Android twins were featured much more in Dragon Ball Super, especially towards the end. It’s one of the flaws of creating such an expansive universe as some characters are bound to be sidelined for a certain amount of time. The only way to get more information on those characters is either to have a whole side arc or series about a particular individual.

In Dragon Ball Super , fans got to see the pure hearts of Android 17 and 18. They battled for their home universe valiantly, and 17 got the wish for winning the Tournament of Power. He could’ve chosen whatever he wanted, even though it was expected he’d ask for something selflessly. He wished back all the erased universes, and it’s an action that a former robot (and someone with “Android” in their name) would never do.

Do you think the Android twins should get their real names brought into the official Dragon Ball canon? Let us know in the comments.
